scope: Local MCP recovery and synthetic service failures; no live requests

checks.name: App release build and three Worker dry builds

acceptance_evidence: Read-only identity derives from existing advertised canonical metadata. Task, agenda, project, goal, exact-task and original-receipt reads return unavailable observations for explicit errors and unreadable replies.
Read failures preserve safe retry metadata, omit saved/outcome uncertainty fields and return no optimistic data/counts.
Mutation errors preserve savedInCompanion null, outcomeUnknown true and original command receipt recovery.
Normal authorization and party/spell/Cron routing remain unchanged.
limitations: Synthetic SDK handling does not qualify real host/model interpretation or live transport failures.
Unavailable original receipts still leave earlier action outcomes uncertain.
